memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: Persistent daily wheals with pruritus, mild angioedema none.
  - Plan: Start levocetirizine 5 mg once daily in the morning; add cetirizine 10 mg at bedtime for breakthrough symptoms. Advise non‑sedating antihistamine regimen, avoid known triggers, keep symptom diary.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux disease
  - Status: Heartburn twice weekly, occasional regurgitation, no dysphagia or weight loss.
  - Plan: Pantoprazole 40 mg before breakfast daily; domperidone 10 mg before meals twice daily; antacid gel as needed SOS. Lifestyle: small frequent meals, avoid late‑night eating, elevate head of bed.
- Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
- Weight: 68 kg; Waist: 84 cm (male, below 90 cm cut‑off).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic urticaria
  - Status: Wheals reduced to 2‑3 days/week, mild itching, no angioedema.
  - Plan: Continue levocetirizine 5 mg OD; cetirizine HS only if breakthrough symptoms persist. Review symptom diary.
- Gastro‑oesophageal reflux disease
  - Status: Heartburn once weekly, no regurgitation.
  - Plan: Pantoprazole 40 mg OD before breakfast; domperidone 10 mg BD before meals; antacid gel SOS. Encourage weight maintenance.
- Due: HbA1c not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
- Weight: 67 kg; Waist: 83 cm (male, <90 cm).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve noticed the hives are much less frequent now – only a couple of times a week and they’re not as itchy. Heartburn has also improved; I only need the antacid gel after spicy meals. Thanks for the meds.
